title: Giving Opinions and Explaining Reasons
context: At B1 it is not enough to say 'I like it'. You need to say what you think, why, and give an example. You also need honest ways to say you are not sure.
contextPersian: در سطح B1 گفتن «دوستش دارم» کافی نیست. باید بگویی چه فکر می‌کنی، چرا، و مثال بزنی. به راه‌های صادقانه‌ای هم برای گفتن اینکه مطمئن نیستی نیاز داری.

expressions.example: In my opinion, working from home is more productive.
expressions.examplePersian: به نظر من، کار کردن در خانه بهره‌وری بیشتری دارد.
expressions.note: A clear way to start a personal view.

expressions.example: I think it's a good idea because it saves time.
expressions.examplePersian: فکر می‌کنم ایدهٔ خوبی است چون در وقت صرفه‌جویی می‌شود.

expressions.example: The reason is that public transport here is slow.
expressions.examplePersian: دلیلش این است که حمل‌ونقل عمومی این‌جا کند است.

expressions.example: The prices are high. That's why many people leave the city.
expressions.examplePersian: قیمت‌ها بالاست. برای همین بسیاری از مردم شهر را ترک می‌کنند.
expressions.note: 'Because' gives the reason; 'that's why' gives the result.

expressions.example: Some jobs can be done online. For example, translation.
expressions.examplePersian: بعضی از کارها آنلاین انجام می‌شوند. برای مثال، ترجمه.

expressions.example: Is it expensive? — It depends on the season.
expressions.examplePersian: گران است؟ — بستگی دارد به فصل.

expressions.example: I'm not sure whether I should accept the job.
expressions.examplePersian: مطمئن نیستم که آیا باید این کار را قبول کنم.

expressions.example: To be honest, I prefer studying in the morning.
expressions.examplePersian: راستش را بخواهی، ترجیح می‌دهم صبح درس بخوانم.

expressions.persian: تا جایی که به من مربوط است، ...
expressions.example: As far as I'm concerned, price matters more than brand.
expressions.examplePersian: از نظر من، قیمت از برند مهم‌تر است.

expressions.example: What matters most is a good team.
expressions.examplePersian: مهم‌ترین چیز یک تیم خوب است.

expressions.persian: من آن را جور دیگری می‌بینم.
expressions.example: Many people say it's easy, but I see it differently.
expressions.examplePersian: خیلی‌ها می‌گویند آسان است، ولی من جور دیگری می‌بینم.

expressions.english: On the one hand..., on the other hand...
expressions.persian: از یک طرف ...، از طرف دیگر ...
expressions.example: On the one hand it is cheap; on the other hand it is slow.
expressions.examplePersian: از یک طرف ارزان است؛ از طرف دیگر کند است.

options: I prefer trains because they are more comfortable.
I prefer trains, so because comfortable.
I prefer trains because of comfortable.

acceptedAnswers: reason
exercises.explanationPersian: برای گفتن دلیل می‌گوییم The reason is that + جمله.

exercises.source: به نظر من، کار کردن در خانه بهره‌وری بیشتری دارد.
acceptedAnswers: In my opinion, working from home is more productive.
In my opinion, working at home is more productive.
In my opinion, remote work is more productive.
In my opinion, working from home is more efficient.

commonErrors.feedbackPersian: بعد از In my opinion جملهٔ کامل بیاید.

exercises.source: دلیلش این است که حمل‌ونقل عمومی این‌جا کند است.
acceptedAnswers: The reason is that public transport here is slow.
The reason is that public transport is slow here.
The reason is that the public transport here is slow.
The reason is that public transportation here is slow.

exercises.source: مطمئن نیستم که آیا باید این کار را قبول کنم.
acceptedAnswers: I'm not sure whether I should accept the job.
I'm not sure if I should accept the job.
I'm not sure whether I should take the job.
I'm not sure whether to accept the job.
I am not sure whether I should accept this job.
I'm not sure whether I should accept this job.

commonErrors.match: not sure that i should|not sure (to|about) if
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: از whether (یا if) استفاده کن: I'm not sure whether …

acceptedAnswers: It depends on the season.
It depends on the time of year.
It depends on the weather.

commonErrors.feedbackPersian: depend با on می‌آید: depends on.

exercises.prompt: "I like living in the city because there is always something to do. But it can be noisy and expensive." What is one disadvantage of the city, according to the speaker?
acceptedAnswers: It is noisy
Noisy
It is expensive
Expensive
Noisy and expensive
It can be noisy

exercises.explanation: The speaker says it can be noisy and expensive.
exercises.explanationPersian: گوینده می‌گوید ممکن است پرسروصدا و گران باشد.

exercises.incorrectSentence: It is depend on the weather.
acceptedAnswers: It depends on the weather.
exercises.explanation: depend is a verb: it depends.

exercises.incorrectSentence: I am not sure if I will to go.
acceptedAnswers: I'm not sure if I will go.

acceptedAnswers: For example, some jobs can be done online.
For example, some jobs can be done on the internet.
For example, some work can be done online.
For example, some tasks can be done online.

exercises.before: Many jobs can now be done remotely.

acceptedAnswers: For
exercises.hint: Two words in the full phrase: ___ example.
exercises.hintPersian: عبارت کامل دو کلمه است: ___ example.
exercises.explanation: For example, + a sentence gives an example.
exercises.explanationPersian: For example, یعنی برای مثال و بعدش یک جمله می‌آید.

speakingTask.instruction: Give your opinion about working from home, with a reason and an example.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: دربارهٔ کار در خانه نظرت را بگو، با یک دلیل و یک مثال.
modelSentences: In my opinion, working from home is more productive.
The reason is that I don't lose time travelling.
For example, I save two hours every day.
But it depends on the job, and I'm not sure whether it suits everyone.

roleplay.aiRole: A colleague who wants to hear your view
roleplay.objective: Explain an opinion, give a reason and an example, and say what it depends on
roleplay.context: A colleague asks what you think about working from home. Give your opinion, explain why, give an example, and say when you are not sure or when it depends on something.
roleplay.opening: I'm curious — what do you think about working from home? Do you prefer it?
